links.outcome: External dataset performance and calibration versus internal MIMIC-IV test performance
links.effect: Without recalibration, AUC/AUPRC were 0.823/0.402 on eICU, 0.831/0.429 on MIMIC-III, and 0.803/0.361 on HiRID versus 0.836/0.481 internally; calibration slopes 0.88, 0.91, 0.85 versus 0.97 internally.
links.quote: Without memory reconstruction or external recalibration, AUC/AUPRC values were 0.823/0.402 on eICU, 0.831/0.429 on MIMIC-III, and 0.803/0.361 on HiRID.

unlisted_practices: Procedural-memory retrieval augmentation (provenance-linked memory cards) for LLM agents in ICU mortality-risk estimation

screen.reason: The paper develops and evaluates an experimental agent architecture (ProMem-Agent) for mortality risk estimation using EHR datasets (MIMIC-IV, eICU, HiRID), but it tests model design/ablation components rather than organizational deployment practices or operational safeguards.
